{{Top|leg}}
The '''flexible underlay''' was an enhancement that increased the suppleness of [[Armor/Legends|armor]], thereby allowing the wearer greater degree of movement. The Mark I, II, III, IV, & V versions in turn boosted the amount of flexibility.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can only be used with heavy armor.
